propositions: Extract jscpd invocation and statistics.total parsing into shared run_jscpd helper callable in analyzers/_jscpd.py, consumed by both the new jscpd_dup adapter and the existing backfill script.
When jscpd is available, analyze(root) returns AnalyzerResult with duplication.clones (int) and duplication.percentage (float) parsed from the JSON report statistics.total.
When jscpd is absent or subprocess raises FileNotFoundError, return Unavailable(reason, _ACCRUING_SINCE) instead of zeros or propagating the error.
Backfill invocation remains bare jscpd binary (no npx wrapper) with unchanged command structure and clone_count return shape.
One shared run_jscpd runner eliminates invocation drift between backfill and adapter; test contract verifies both modules reference the same callable and exact statistics parsing.
